scope: Actual System allocator, identical shared prepare_file/capture/execute upload and download file pipeline. Each trial generates and prepares 32MiB sources before measured phases; same explicit profile, encrypted key, immediate simulated bounded frontend, helper/private IPC/OpenSSH and known-host checks, source/mtime/type guards, no-replace atomic destination, explicit cleanup and final tracked budget zero. Direct control runs synchronously on harness test thread, no queue/workers; pool uses actual Service with two workers and one reaper, same 16MiB child/input ceiling/9MiB policy. Direct lacks queue/backpressure/cancel/GUI contract and is not a deployable UI alternative. Start API, two full file job lifecycles (including connection/auth and common frontend thread), pool joined cleanup measured; 300ms idle before/after excluded from active total. Byte verification after phases. Two warmups each, five alternating pairs. Client and separate owned server sampled every 5ms, up to64pids/tree. CPU sums per-observed-pid min/max deltas: lower bound missing short-lived/edge CPU, not complete child lifetime CPU; RSS is sampled sums, not whole-process memory hard cap or allocator accounting. No native window/input presentation, real remote latency, hostile/fault equivalence or 30-minute idle claim.
